title: The Power of Kingdom Ambassadors
paragraphs: We have been teaching in the Kingdom series all year and we have another year to complete. Therefore, we have much to learn about this very important subject, the Kingdom of God. I want to begin with a simple review, so to speak, of the talk about the mission of the Church, the Kingdom, and the Church. The Kingdom and the Church are two different things. They are not identical. The church and the kingdom are not synonymous. Christianity has largely made the church and the kingdom of God one and the same.

I think this is one of the biggest forms of confusion we have faced over the past 1800 years. The church is not the kingdom. The Kingdom of God is separate from the Church, but the Church is not separate from the Kingdom of God. The Kingdom existed before the Church. The church as we know it now, this thing we call a church, in the true sense, is not really the church. Ephesians chapter three provides a statement.

Ephesians chapter 3, verse 10 says: His purpose was that the variable wisdom of God should now be made known through the church to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms, according to the purpose of the ages. The service of the church was to make known the manifest or varied wisdom of God to the earth. Now, I'm going to go through some information very quickly, so you need to write quickly to see if we can form an idea of ​​what a church is.

The key to the kingdom was the influence of heaven on earth, and this principle in particular is of paramount importance. God’s intention was to influence the earth from heaven through his sons, his children, without himself coming to the earth. Therefore, the Kingdom of Heaven wants to influence the earth through the mechanism of the family. The fall of man, therefore, was not really a fall from heaven, but rather a fall from representing God on earth. Man has fallen from sovereignty over the earth.

He lost the power to legally rule on the land. This is what he lost when he disobeyed God. Therefore, man fell from sovereignty because he lost the connection that bound him to God. Communication has been lost. The Holy Spirit departed from the human soul. The human being became an actor without official documents. The Holy Spirit has been lost. The Holy Spirit is the link between man and heaven. When Adam sinned, he became an unholy vessel. Therefore, the Holy Spirit can no longer dwell in an unholy vessel.

Thus, the Holy Spirit was forced to leave. Let's talk about the Kingdom of God and the Kingdom of Heaven. Let's talk about the differences between them. Jesus uses these two terms in all of his teachings. Sometimes the term Kingdom of God is used. At other times the term Kingdom of Heaven is used. These two expressions do not mean the same thing. What is the Kingdom of Heaven?

The Kingdom of Heaven is the realm of Heaven, the literal place where the King or God himself rules and exercises his authority and power over that earth. Therefore, the term Kingdom of Heaven refers to a place. But the kingdom of God is a little different. What is the Kingdom of God? The Kingdom of God is any domain or territory where God’s sovereignty, influence, or authority is in effect. Please take note of this because you will not understand the Bible unless you grasp these two unique concepts.

The Kingdom of Heaven is a place. The kingdom of God is the influence of that place over any land. The Kingdom of God already exists in heaven because God influences heaven. Simply put, the sky is his land where he resides. Any other place where the Kingdom of God exerts influence is called the Kingdom of God in that place. Therefore, to understand these concepts, we must realize that the Kingdom of Heaven and the Kingdom of God are both from God.

Matthew 25:34 is a statement that speaks of the age of the Kingdom of God. Let's see how old it is. Verse 34 of Matthew 25 says: Then the King will say to those on his right, “You are blessed by my Father.” Inherit your inheritance. What is your inheritance? Please speak loudly. How long has the kingdom been prepared for you? Since the founding of the world. How long did the kingdom exist? It existed before the earth was created. The Kingdom existed before you were created.

Therefore, the Kingdom of God, the Kingdom that Jesus came to preach, precedes the earth and precedes us. The Kingdom of God is God's sovereignty over a certain land. What is a church? How does the church get involved in this matter? Jesus came preaching the Kingdom of God. We know what he preached clearly in Matthew 4:17. His first public statement was, “You should now be able to say it by heart.” From that time Jesus began to preach. I quote from holy books. Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

Where was he when he said that? On the ground. What was he referring to? To heaven. What did it mean? It meant that the heavens were finally able to influence the earth again. The influence of God's kingdom has been brought to Earth. Can you tell me how he did that? Does anyone among the viewers want to answer? How do I get it... Thank you. You are at the top of the class. I received a privilege. You must be one of my sons. He said that he brought it about through the Holy Spirit. This is the key.

The Holy Spirit is the presence of God somewhere. When Jesus came, he brought the Holy Spirit with him. What did Adam lose? Holy Spirit. So Jesus regained access from heaven to earth. He restored the connection between heaven and earth once again. That is why he was able to declare: Change your thinking, for the kingdom of heaven has arrived again. He's here. Then he continues and begins to teach about this kingdom over and over again. He knows about the kingdom.

Then in the Gospel of Matthew, chapter 16, he says this. And I tell you that you are Peter. But on this rock where I said, “I am the Christ,” I will build my church, and the gates of hell, that is, the tomb, will not prevail against it. Let me remind you, if you weren't here in the previous part, that the word "hell" in your English translation of King James is not accurate because what is your concept of hell? Fire, isn't it? Okay.

Therefore, the King James Version says that the gates of hell will not prevail against it. This does not indicate the location of the fire. There are three words for hell in the Greek language, and all three are used in the four Gospels. These three words mean completely different things, but the King James Version did not translate these words well because it used the word hell in every instance, but it does not mean hell in the sense that you consider it to be like fire.

The first word in Greek for hell is "Gehena". "Jehina" was a place they called, and it was more like a garbage dump. It is derived from the word "Jehina," which is a valley located between Jerusalem and Bethany. There is a valley. You have to walk through a valley to reach Jerusalem on the hill. That valley was called "Jehena". That's where they dumped all the waste. They were burning waste there 24 hours a day. In other words, it was always on fire.

People were dumping waste, just like we do here in the Bahamas and other countries, and burning it everywhere. So, let me smell the smoke. Well, this place is called Gehem (Hennum Valley). Jehim Valley. This is where they used to burn everything. So when Jesus was teaching about hell, he looked at this burning valley and said: Look, if you die without God, you will be in a place like this. Therefore, he referred to the word Gehem, the place of burning. This is one word that they translate as hell.

The next word is the word "sheol". Sheol is a Greek word that refers to a place of torment, a place of suffering. It is also a waiting place. And now, when you die and you do not know Christ, you go to a place where you wait until the Day of Judgment. Well, that's where it's referred to in Greek. They also translate that word as hell. But this other word really did cause some problems. This word, the word they use to talk about hell here, is Hades. Hades points to the cemetery.

Can you imagine confusing a cemetery with hell and fire? This is what you did by reading the King James Version. Why did Jesus use the word Hades? He does not use the word "sheol" here. He uses it in another context, but he did not use it here. He does not use the word "Jihim". He uses the word Hades. My church says that neither death nor the grave can stop it. Why? Because my church is very strong. Anyone who is part of my government, if they die, will return.

In other words, the resurrection ensures that death cannot stop my government. That's what he was saying. I will establish a government to rule the earth for God, and death cannot stop it. So if your mother dies, or your father dies, or your cousin dies, or if you die, this does not prevent you from returning to rule. You will restore your body in the name of the great Jesus. Because he rose from the dead. But the point I want you to understand here is that he is talking about something called the church.

He says: On this confession that I am the Christ, I will build my church. The word church here is the Greek word he uses: ecclesia. Can you write this word? Ecclesia means the invited ones. It does not mean a building with a tower, seats, and a pulpit. The church has no connection to the building. The church has no connection to the building. You cannot go to church. The word used has no relation to a location, nor to a physical facility. The word he used refers to a select group of people.

"Ecclesia" means those invited out. Therefore, the church is a group of people who will serve as an agency through which God aims to re-establish his rule on earth. Please write that down. I will give you a definition of the church. The church is a select group, a called community of people chosen by God to be an agency. Let everyone say "agency". An agency is a company that represents another company. Most insurance workers work for an agency. They do not work for the company in Canada.

They have an agency in the Bahamas that represents the company in Canada. Do you understand what I'm talking about? Now, the company in the Bahamas, which is an insurance agency, is not the parent company. They simply acquire customers for the parent company and take a commission in return. Huh. Therefore, the agency cannot make decisions on behalf of the company. The company makes the decisions for the agency. Calm down, everyone. What happened?

If you are an insurance agent working for an agency in the Bahamas, your company's leadership there cannot sit and dictate the direction of that company. This is decided in another country. That's the agency. That 's why you're called an insurance agent. You do not own the company. They control how you get paid. The amount of commission you receive. Everything is decided elsewhere. This is the meaning of "ecclesia". "Ecclesia" is an agency of people who represent a state or government.

This means they cannot sit down and decide what to do. They should always receive instructions from the company they work for. Come on, talk to me. Are you okay? This is what "Ecclesia" means. Therefore, you cannot decide how you will live your life. You need to get instructions from the company you work for. You cannot decide how she will dress. You need to get instructions from the company. You are just an agent. It's an agency. Let's see how this works.

It is therefore very important to understand what the church is. quickly. "Ecclesia" means the chosen ones, the appointed ones, the ones called to go out. It is a word invented by the Greeks, not by Jesus. It was a concept used by the Roman government. Therefore, the word church was not invented by Jesus. The word church is not of Jesus origin. This is important because we believe in a way that we are the Church and they are the devils. Speaking of the government.

No, the Roman government was the first to establish a church. What is a church? Certain people, selected, invited. The Roman government, headed by Emperor Caesar. Caesar is the word that means master. He would select certain groups from among the people whose job was to take his mind and intention and turn it into legislation, and to rule the entire empire with this legislation. In other words, Caesar appointed or selected individuals to be his government. At that time, they were called the Senate.

Today our Senate is a little different. In the Roman Empire, the Senate was the government. We still use some of the ideas of the Roman government, but the Romans derived their ideas from the Greeks. The Greeks were the ones who invented the word "democracy". That's a Greek word, "democracy". It was invented by Plato and Aristotle. "Democracy," from which we got the word democracy. Democracy is a representative government. That's where it came from. It is a Greek concept.

The Bahamas, America, and all these democracies actually live according to a Greek concept, not a biblical one. But the democratic concept contains some elements of a monarchy when it comes to representation, except that power goes in the opposite direction. In a democracy, power is transferred from the bottom up. In the kingdom, power is transferred from the top down. In a democracy, you decide who leads you. In the kingdom, the king decides who follows him.

In a democracy, you vote for the person to come to power. In the kingdom, you have no voice. Are you with me? Therefore, the "ecclesia" (church) is important. It is the government of the Romans. The word church is used. Caesar had a church, which was a group of individuals he appointed to represent his ideas. Wherever they went, they had to make the place they went to look just like Rome. The purpose of electing a government is to carry out the ruler's orders.

So, the job is, follow me now, let everyone look at me, it's a very important phrase, isn't it? Really, really, okay? The job of a minister in the government or the Senate at that time was to spend a lot of time with Caesar. Why? Because their responsibility, and I have said their responsibility, was to get into Caesar's mind. Are you all listening? That is the government's job. The government should not have its own ideology. The government must possess the mindset of an emperor.

Therefore, they spend hours with the emperor and listen to him speak. When he speaks, he expresses what he wants in the empire. Well, I want to do this, and I want to do that. He is speaking. While he is speaking, they have scribes—and the word scribe means to write—who write down everything he says. And when they get the information from his head, their job is to make it law. And he made it legislation.

Then implement it throughout the entire empire, so that everything Caesar had in mind would happen throughout the entire kingdom. Is this clear? That is the ecclesia (church). Now if I read the Bible, I want to go back to the Bible. I want to show you the Bible because we sometimes overlook it. Look at Matthew 16:18. It says, Jesus asked the question: Who do people say I am? Do you remember?

They said: Some say that you are the Prophet, some say that you are Elijah who returned, some say that you are John the Baptist, some say that you are such and such, etc. Then he said: Well, who do you say I am? Peter replied, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.” Now, let me tell you what that phrase means. That phrase means that you are the Lord from God. You didn't understand that. This is dangerous, because you see, there is only one lord in every kingdom.

Therefore, when Peter said: You are the Lord from God, you are the Messiah whom God promised, you are the Lord whom God spoke of through the prophets. He says: I understand you, Jesus. I know who you are. You are the Lord from God. Christ says: On this confession, not on Peter's, on this confession, I will build my council of ministers. Do you understand? No, you still don't understand. Now you can cheer a little over there. He said: Look, the fact that I am the Lord from God, I am from another place.

I represent another country and another government. And on this fact, I will build my Senate. Now, look at my words “my church”. He did not say "the church". He could not say "church" because " church" meant that it was the only one. He knew that Caesar had one on the way to Rome. He now says that Caesar has his church and that it was born under his rule. I was born under the Roman Empire. I am under domination. I am under colonialism. I am a colonizer of Rome. I am a prisoner of their laws.

He said, "But I have some news for Caesar." Perhaps you can say "Amen" anyway. I live in the Bahamas. I am subject to Bahamian law, but I have some news for the Prime Minister. This means that I am not simply a victim of the government's laws and economy. I don't live my life based on economic circumstances, whether there is a job or not, or whether hotels close or open, I don't care. I live under another government. You don't realize how important this is. When you get fired from your job, there's no problem.

Just use your other passport and say that my government will provide for all my needs. It's a completely new concept. He said, "Based on this fact, I will build my cabinet." If you notice, in every kingdom, members of the government are not chosen by election. Come on, this is very important. You do not elect the cabinet. No one in our country, nor in America, nor in Africa, nor anywhere, elects members of the government. You do not elect the Cabinet, nor do you elect the Senate.

The members of the government are chosen by one person in each kingdom, only one person. Make sure of that. Who is this person? The Prime Minister, or the President, or the King. This is important to you, because in order for you to join Jesus’ cabinet, if we had to vote for you, half of us don’t like you, and the rest wish you weren’t here. I mean, we know your past, girl. We know what you were doing. We know what you've been drinking. We know what you were smoking, and who you were sleeping with.

We vote for you to be on Jesus' side? Are you crazy? You will never succeed in that. Raise your hands and thank God that you are not elected to Jesus' cabinet. Oh, I'm about to cheer all by myself. Look, it doesn't matter what you think about some of our government ministers. This is none of your business. The Prime Minister chooses whomever he wants. Now, what's interesting about the Cabinet is that if the Prime Minister thinks you're not doing your job, there will be a cabinet reshuffle. God is the same.

Christ says that in my kingdom I will give you gifts to invest. And if you don't invest it properly, I will come and take what I gave you, and give it to the person who is working. Tell your neighbor that no one will take my job. Go ahead, say it as if you believe it from the depths of your soul. No one will take my job. Clap your hands and glorify God. No one will take my job. I will work for God. Therefore, he says "my church," referring to his own church. What then is the church?

The Church is the living organism of humanity. The Cabinet in the Bahamas, the United States, Nigeria, or Jamaica is not a building. It is a group of people, living people. The church is a group of living people. Your country's cabinet can meet anywhere they wish. Did you know that? If they met in a hotel room, guess what? That is the Cabinet Room. They can meet on a bus somewhere. That is the Cabinet Room. When terrorists struck the building on September 11th. What happened?

Bush was in a plane, flying through the air. The message was sent to the cabinet to meet in a hideout somewhere. In other words, the government is where the cabinet is located. Wherever there is a cabinet, there is a government. The government here in Washington is where the cabinet meets with the president. You don't understand. You are looking at me with surprise. Jesus said: “Woman, look, John 4 says: ‘ You worship in the mountains, but the Jews worship in the temple.’” You are both wrong.

He said: The day has come. You are slow to understand. He said: God does not gather in any building on the mountain or in Jerusalem. He said: Rather, my government meets wherever two people meet in my name. There I am, I will stop preaching. You can make God's government in your kitchen. Pick up the phone, call Mo'men, make a deal, and the government is in the kitchen. He said: My government will convene wherever I find worshippers ready to worship me.

It does n't matter where, it's about spirit, sincere belief, and truth. He said: When they do that, we are in the middle of them. That is why we named this place what we named it. You will understand that soon. The church is a living community of people. Third, the Church is God's legal agency on earth. What do we mean by that? The most important word when you write that is to underline the word " legal". The Church is God's legal agency on earth. What is a church?

The church is not an institution made up of a collection of organizations, robes, crowns, crosses, and all these things that we have here. Actually, I'm starting to feel a little confused, and please don't turn off the TV. I started to feel confused about the church and all these other things. The church is not an organization, nor is it a building. But what else? A group of invited people who represent the king's thinking. This man is in the House of Representatives. The church is the administrative arm of God's government on earth. Isn't this wonderful? What is a church? The administrative arm of God's government. Every government must have an administration. The minister's job is to organize the people in a way that makes the prime minister's ideas manifest in the country. This is what is called management. But that is what the church represents.

The church is God's called and responsible community for administering heavenly ideas on earth. This is the only thing God wants. God is not... oh my God. No, that's not...
